description: This file defines a class 'MyAdmin' that extends 'DeviceAdminReceiver', handling device administrator events such as enabling and disabling device administration. It includes methods to get the component, check if admin is active, disable admin, and reacts to enable/disable events by calling 'MyMain.restart'.

classes.name: MyAdmin
classes.description: Extends DeviceAdminReceiver, manages device admin events such as enabling and disabling admin rights. Provides static methods to obtain component reference, check admin status, and disable admin rights. Reacts to admin being enabled or disabled by calling 'MyMain.restart'.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns a ComponentName object representing this class and the provided context.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if this device admin component is currently active/enabled.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Removes active admin rights for this component.

methods.name: onEnabled
methods.description: Callback invoked when device admin is enabled; restarts MyMain.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Callback invoked when device admin is disabled; restarts MyMain.
